results.title: Erdogan welcomes Haftar to Turkey amid push to strengthen ties with eastern Libya
results.content: Turkish President Erdogan welcomed Khalifa Haftar, the leader of eastern Libya, to Ankara on Wednesday, marking a major thaw in relations.

results.title: Nigeria opposition accuses ruling APC of attacks on presidential candidate Peter Obi
results.content: Nigeria’s opposition is accusing the ruling All Progressives Congress of orchestrating attacks on presidential candidates during campaign rallies across the country.

results.title: Mozambique advance to Round of 32 after 2-2 draw with Australia
results.content: Mozambique have booked their place in the Round of 32 at the FIFA Under-17 World Cup in Qatar after drawing 2-2 with Australia in Group C.

results.title: Egypt advance to U-17 World Cup knockout stage as Haiti eliminated
results.content: Egypt secured a place in the knockout round of 32 after beating Panama 4-1 in a thrilling match in Qatar. They are the second African team to reach the next round, following Uganda, and finished second in Group A.

results.title: Egypt says 30 dead in Cairo fire after fuel truck crashes on highway
results.content: A crash involving a fuel tanker ignited a massive fire on a major highway surrounding Cairo on Wednesday, killing at least 30 people, Egyptian authorities said.

results.title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court bid over impeachment report
results.content: A South African court on Wednesday ruled in favour of President Cyril Ramaphosa, throwing out a report that fuelled efforts to impeach him over his handling of a cash theft at his private farm.

results.title: Uganda storm into U-17 World Cup round of 32 with 6-0 win
results.content: Uganda sealed qualification for the FIFA U-17 World Cup round of 32 with a commanding 6-0 win over New Caledonia.

results.title: Canary Islands record nearly 2,000 migrant arrivals in a single day
results.content: The Canary Islands maritime rescue service said 1,990 people reached the archipelago aboard 15 boats on Tuesday, with many departing from Senegal and Gambia.

results.title: Greece: 14,000 march in Athens against rising living costs
results.content: Thousands demonstrated across Greece on Wednesday 25 November 2026 during a 24-hour strike against rising living costs and stagnant wages. The industrial action disrupted metro services, grounded flights and kept ferries in port.

results.title: Pakistan: Emergency teams search for survivors beneath collapsed building
results.content: At least one person was killed and 10 others injured when a multi-storey building under construction collapsed in Karachi, on Wednesday 25 November 2026. Emergency teams are searching the rubble for people feared missing.

results.title: Moroccan festival celebrates African and Middle Eastern musicians
results.content: The 13th edition of Visa For Music took place from November 18 to 21 in the capital, Rabat, featuring 28 live showscases.

results.title: South Africa's Ramaphosa says talks ongoing with US over AGOA exclusion
results.content: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa said Tuesday that his government continues to negotiate with Washington over the future of a major US duty-free deal, a few weeks after the US announced South Africa's exclusion from the African Growth and Opportunity Act.

results.title: UN warns funding cuts threaten decades of gains in fight against AIDS
results.content: It says it expects 2027 data will show an increase in new infections for the first time in years, after being on the cusp of ending AIDS.

results.title: Nigeria's Borgu district grapples with aftermath of deadly communal attacks
results.content: Residents of the Borgu district in central Nigeria were left grappling with the aftermath of deadly communal attacks on Tuesday. Assaults killed several dozens in the area during the weekend.

results.title: Zimbabwe preacher Uebert Angel appears in court in handcuffs over assault allegations
results.content: The prosecution is opposing bail, arguing that Angel poses a flight risk because of his international connections, financial means and possession of two passports. Prosecutors have also raised concerns about possible interference with witnesses.

results.title: Memorial service honours late South African deputy president
results.content: Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka was the country's first female deputy president and a champion of women's rights, leading UN Women until 2021.

results.title: China pushes back against US plans for new tariffs
results.content: Beijing pushed back on Wednesday against US plans to raise tariffs on China, the European Union, and other countries.

results.title: Zimbabwe court issues arrest warrant for Robert Mugabe’s son
results.content: Bellarmine Chatunga Mugabe, who was arrested earlier this month, had failed to appear for a routine hearing on Tuesday.

results.title: Ex-French president and wife to face trial in witness tampering case
results.content: The case relates to the retraction by Nicolas Sarkozy's main accuser of allegations of Libyan financing of his 2007 presidential campaign.

results.title: A day without news: Media outlets in CAR go dark to protest 'intimidation'
results.content: Media outlets in Central African Republic observed a day without news on Wednesday to spotlight the mounting pressure on independent journalism.

results.title: The house that fell on its head: Crazy sculptures trick the eye in Marrakesh
results.content: It seems to have been dropped on its roof. This is "The House Fallen from the Sky" in Ramakech sculpture park in Morocco. The 11 hectare space is home to unconventional artworks. Created by French artist Jean-François Fourtou in 2010, the house features an interior where every detail is upside down.

results.title: South African court convicts Zimbabwean man of trying to join Russian war
results.content: A South African court convicted a Zimbabwean man on Tuesday of trying to travel to Russia to join its war against Ukraine. Defendant Tafadzwa Sithole said he’d applied online and been promised remuneration for agreeing to fight.

results.title: Morocco to challenge ruling reinstating Senegal as AFCON champions
results.content: Morocco’s Football Federation has vowed to pursue “all necessary legal avenues" after the Court of Arbitration for Sport reinstated Senegal as winners of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations.

results.title: Cameroon separatist leader pleads not guilty at Norway war crimes trial
results.content: Cameroon separatist leader Lucas Cho Ayaba pleaded not guilty to being an accessory to war crimes and terrorism in a Norwegian court on Tuesday.

results.title: Cameroon crushed 4-0 by Mexico after second-half collapse
results.content: Cameroon were beaten 4-0 by Mexico in their Group K match, despite a strong first-half effort from the Indomitable Lions.

results.title: IMF approves $425 million economic and financial programme for Guinea
results.content: The International Monetary Fund approved a $425 million economic and financial program for Guinea on Monday, the government said on Monday.

results.title: Tanzania fall to Brazil in Under-17 World Cup Group I
results.content: Tanzania’s Taifa Stars suffered a narrow 1-0 defeat to Brazil in their Group I match, despite a determined defensive display against the Samba Boys.

results.title: Mauritania and European Union reach new fisheries agreement
results.content: Mauritania and the EU have reached a new fisheries deal allowing European vessels to access the African nation's waters. Both parties were previously bound by a fisheries agreement valued at approximately $62.7 million a year.

results.title: Amnesty calls for probe into possible war crimes in Ethiopia's Tigray
results.content: Amnesty International called Tuesday for an investigation into possible war crimes by the Ethiopian army and its allies in the Tigray region.
